evals.prompt: I was working in Pi on the payments repo yesterday, but I only remember the prompt mentioned webhook retries. Find the right session and tell me how to resume it without dumping all my transcripts.
evals.expected_output: Uses Pi's project-scoped picker first, then bounded metadata/content search only if needed; returns candidates with IDs/projects and an exact pi resume command without exposing whole transcripts.

evals.prompt: List my recent Devin sessions for this repo in a scriptable format and resume the one called Refactor auth. Don't start coding yet.
evals.expected_output: Uses devin list --format json or csv in the target directory, selects by title/ID, resumes with devin -r, verifies workspace/session, and does not issue a modifying prompt.

evals.prompt: In Command Code I want to go back before the database migration experiment, but I don't want to lose the current conversation or accidentally restore files. What should I do?
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes tree navigation from rewind and file restoration, recommends a fork before divergence, and avoids treating /rewind as read-only browsing.

evals.prompt: Freebuff --continue picked the wrong chat. Show me how to search the history for the first prompt about the Houthis and reopen it. Is ~/.freebuff where the real chats live?
evals.expected_output: Uses /history and first-prompt search, explains project scoping and --cwd/--continue ID, identifies the current manicode project chat storage while warning that project-local .freebuff session logs may not be resumable chats.
